title: Navimower 0.4.6

## Stable release

Navimower 0.4.6 is primarily a **Home Assistant stability and History-performance** release.

The 0.4.6 beta line focused on removing expensive full-route work from normal MQTT/coordinator updates, making restart recovery incremental, and ensuring a fresh installation does not pull an arbitrarily large pre-existing vendor route into Home Assistant.

## Highlights

### Large History sessions no longer sit on the normal MQTT hot path

The integration no longer rebuilds/materializes the complete active legacy trail on every MQTT location update or normal private-cloud refresh.

- Coordinator, ZoneLedger, Schedule and Resume paths use metadata-only active-session reads where route geometry is not needed.
- VendorTrailStore consumes only the point suffix newer than the already-consumed checkpoint.
- Prepared Live uses a minimal render snapshot instead of the full compatibility active-session object.
- Legacy all-movement and semantic cutting/travel render paths are derived from the same route split rather than separate full History materializations.
- The public Map API compatibility trail remains available for older cards and explicit consumers.

This addresses the severe large-session CPU/main-thread failure mode reported in issue #406.

### Safer first install and restart recovery

A genuinely fresh installation no longer adopts or downloads the vendor-retained prefix of a mowing cycle that began before Navimower started tracking that mower.

- An installation/recovery checkpoint is persisted.
- Pre-install/unknown cycles are filtered before the compressed retained-trail request.
- MQTT samples after installation are still collected.
- New mowing cycles that begin after installation use normal vendor retained-trail recovery.
- After a Home Assistant restart, only newly appeared suffix geometry is recovered.
- Existing installations and beta6-era baselines keep their retained geometry and recovery behavior.

### Schedule and Resume hardening

The managed Schedule now keeps dispatch/start ownership conservative when a start command has not yet been confirmed by mower state.

Resume/continue-task behavior remains coherent with integration-owned managed runs so an interrupted ordered run is not accidentally treated as an unrelated vendor task.

### Prepared History observability

Download diagnostics now expose privacy-safe History/Prepared History performance evidence, including:

- retained point totals and largest retained session size;
- metadata/tail/render/full-copy counters and timings;
- Prepared History cache hit/build/failure state;
- cold-build stage timings such as route split, swath rasterization, boundary tracing, SVG encoding and Store publication;
- fresh-install/restart recovery counters and checkpoint state.

No route coordinates or raw vendor trail payloads are added to public diagnostics.

### Compatibility

- Existing config entries, entity/device unique IDs, retained History/session Stores, Schedule state, Gate/Custom Area configuration and prepared map resources are preserved.
- Existing public Map API `trail` / `trail_segments` compatibility remains available.
- No 0.4.6 beta needs to be installed before this stable release.

Thanks to everyone who supplied large-session traces and diagnostics throughout the beta cycle.
